findings.claim: Only two of the three unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] diagnostic paths identified in the requirement are changed. The remaining path at the reporter's TypeCollector.cs:735 can still evaluate the indexer before reportDiagnostic is invoked; the new ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wrapper runs too late to prevent that exception. Thus a metadata symbol that reaches this third diagnostic can still crash the analyzer or generator, contrary to the criterion that diagnostics requiring a source location must not crash for symbols without declaring syntax.

receipt_plan.detail: Inspect the remaining DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] access at the reporter-identified third diagnostic path (TypeCollector.cs:735 in the issue revision). The hunk changes only the accesses around new lines 982 and 1074. Diagnostic.Create arguments are evaluated before reportDiagnostic.Invoke and therefore before ReportIfLocatedInCompilation can filter the diagnostic, so FirstOrDefault-based location handling (or an equivalent source-symbol guard) is still required at the third access.
